title: Recovery Route Points on Lump-Sum Settlements of Deficiency Balance Accounts
content:
**Rule.** The lump-sum settlement percent of an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts is read against the recovery method on the Repossession and Collateral Recovery case that produced the account: a recovery method of involuntary recovery adds 3.0 percentage points, a recovery method of impound release adds 1.5 points, and a recovery method of voluntary surrender adds no points.

| Recovery method on the recovery case | Points added |
|---|---|
| Involuntary recovery | 3.0 |
| Impound release | 1.5 |
| Voluntary surrender | None |

## Points of reading

- The recovery method states how the vehicle came into the company's possession; it is read from the recovery case recorded on the account as the one whose sale produced the deficiency.
- Whether a key came in with the vehicle does not change these points.
- Hypothetically, a vehicle released from an impound lot to the company adds 1.5 points; a vehicle the borrower brought in adds none.
